headline: Election strategist begins charging candidates rent for square footage occupied by their alliance photos on hoardings
body: A prominent political consultant has officially introduced 'spatial synergy fees,' forcing parties to pay per-inch for the visual proximity required to project a united electoral front. The move follows reports that alliance partners have begun negotiating sublets on shared campaign posters to offset rising printing costs.
caption: When the political alliance budget is so tight that your coalition partner starts charging you for pixels. The struggle for unity is getting literal. #ElectionSeason #Politics #IndiaPol #TafriTimes (satire)
igHook: Would you pay a premium just to appear on a billboard next to your political rival?
imagePrompt: A wide angle shot of a weathered roadside billboard frame with partially torn election posters layered over each other in an urban Indian setting.
